request.state: Judge this demonstrated draft language gap. Candidate belongs to Vacancy at one storage owner. Requirements prescribe personal-data/attachment expiry 180 days after vacancy closure and no expiry from this policy while it remains open. Vacancy.close records closed_at=now with open=false; explicit reopening clears closed_at and restores intake only for unexpired candidates, and later reclosure starts a new interval. Expired data can never be resurrected even if physical cleanup remains pending: owner admission evaluates overdue expiry before allowing configuration writes. DESIGN7.1 currently requires retain Model until=expr to yield a nonnull datetime; no independent lifetime is the behavior of an absent declaration, and child deadlines cannot exceed finite ancestor deadlines. Dependencies must remain bounded and owner-local, excluding now,actor,operation and randomness. Current expression grammar has no ternary. A typed pure derive already supports block if/return, so a nullable datetime can be computed without new expression syntax. Physical cleanup, incoming-reference blocks, archived records, snapshots/outbox/files, replay and locks retain their existing lifetime rules. Runtime support does not yet exist. Advice is not approval.

closure_lifetime.instructions: Which bounded repair best preserves the requested closure lifecycle with the existing syntax?

criteria.nullable_deadline: Allow retain until to return datetime?; null supplies no independent deadline, while a finite ancestor still constrains a contained child. Compute the value with an existing nullable pure derive and if/return (closed_at plus retention_days when nonnull, otherwise null). It reuses syntax and lets null deadlines cover more models, requiring explicit semantic checks for null/ancestor transitions and no resurrection.
criteria.condition_clause: Keep retain until nonnull and introduce a separate condition attribute controlling when retention is active. It expresses closure directly but expands retention syntax and creates two expressions whose activation/deadline and ancestor transitions need validation.
criteria.finite_intake: Give each candidate a finite deadline at intake and renew it if a vacancy stays open. This uses current nonnull declarations but requires extra renewal work, can expire open applicants and changes the specified closure-only lifetime.
